notes: Documented KV-cache memory for the 27B hybrid-attention backbone on the PrismML llama.cpp fork: 64 KiB per token in FP16 and about 18 KiB per token in Q4_0, so a 100K-token context needs about 6.3 GiB instead of about 1.8 GiB, a documented roughly 3.5x reduction. Q4_0 requires flash attention, which the documented scripts already enable, and is passed as --cache-type-k q4_0 --cache-type-v q4_0. SCOPE LIMITS: the 100K example context is not the Atlas 8192-token text baseline; the figures are KV-cache allocations, not a full-device peak; no GPU model, driver, batch state or offload state is published for them; and because the backbone is ~75% linear attention this per-token rate is NOT the standard full-attention KV equation and is never substituted for it.
